## Verifiable Project Portfolio

### 1. GEHU Connect (Flagship Campus Application)
- Type: Production Mobile Application
- Status: Deployed and actively maintained
- Verified User Base: Approximately 1,000 active students at Graphic Era Hill University
- Architecture:
  - Client: React Native with Expo cross-platform build pipeline (iOS and Android)
  - Backend API: Spring Boot in Java with REST endpoints for user authentication, student profiles, community channels, and campus notices
  - Storage & Media: Cloudflare R2 object storage accessed via the AWS SDK for scalable image uploads without application server overhead
  - Purpose: Unifies fragmented WhatsApp groups, college notice boards, and student queries into one reliable native mobile feed designed to handle spotty campus Wi-Fi networks.

### 2. Netwich (macOS Multi-Interface Network Bonding)
- Type: Native Desktop Application (macOS 14 and later)
- Status: Completed and released on GitHub
- Technology Stack: Swift 6, SwiftUI, SOCKS5, Apple IP_BOUND_IF socket control
- Key Engineering Highlights:
  - Runs a local lightweight SOCKS5 proxy bound to 127.0.0.1:1080.
  - Bonds multiple active internet interfaces (office Wi-Fi, USB tethered mobile, Ethernet) simultaneously.
  - Employs weighted least-connections scheduling and continuous EWMA health scoring to gracefully deprioritize degraded links without dropping established socket connections.
  - Features byte-range chunking to accelerate single large downloads across all live channels.
  - Zero external telemetry, zero recurring background daemons, idling at less than 0.5% CPU.

### 3. ARANYA (Geospatial Wildlife Intelligence Platform)
- Type: Geospatial Web Platform
- Status: In active hackathon development
- Technology Stack: JavaScript, Geospatial Mapping, Telemetry Ingestion
- Pilot Region: Uttarakhand, India (specifically monitoring the sensitive Rajaji-Corbett wildlife migration corridor)
- Purpose: Reconciles sparse, fragmented forest ranger records and camera-trap telemetry into an actionable predictive heat map for wildlife-human conflict mitigation.

### 4. ORVESS-PAT (Optical Tracking & Communications Simulation)
- Type: Scientific Simulation Suite
- Status: ISRO Smart India Hackathon problem exploration
- Technology Stack: Python, Numerical Simulation, Monte Carlo Methods
- Key Capabilities:
  - Focal-plane array sensor modeling with sub-pixel centroid calculation (achieving sigma = 0.18 pixel accuracy below raw sensor pitch).
  - Adaptive signal quality scoring and noise filtering under simulated deep-space atmospheric turbulence.

### 5. Meghavyuha (Adaptive Meteorological Intelligence)
- Type: Deployed Web Application
- Status: Active prototype on Vercel (meghavyuha.vercel.app)
- Technology Stack: TypeScript, Modern Next.js
- Purpose: District-level weather forecast reconciliation, correction weights, and localized rainfall anomaly modeling.
